title: zeus-llm-usage: provider windows
description: A54 static mapping of the provider-window panels (DESIGN §3.8, §6). W2 provisions the full dashboard from these panels; nothing here is installed.

panels.title: Window state five_hour
panels.description: Reported by the provider; not derived from token counts. 1 current, 2 stale, 3 expired, 4 unavailable; an older valid value is never shown as current.

targets.expr: sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="five_hour",state="current"}) * 1 + sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="five_hour",state="stale"}) * 2 + sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="five_hour",state="expired"}) * 3 + sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="five_hour",state="unavailable"}) * 4

4.text: Unavailable: newest observation has no valid reading for this window

panels.title: Window utilization five_hour
panels.description: Reported by the provider; not derived from token counts. Shown for current and stale windows only.

panels.title: Window state seven_day
panels.description: Reported by the provider; not derived from token counts. 1 current, 2 stale, 3 expired, 4 unavailable; an older valid value is never shown as current.

targets.expr: sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="seven_day",state="current"}) * 1 + sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="seven_day",state="stale"}) * 2 + sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="seven_day",state="expired"}) * 3 + sum by (slot) (zeus_llm_provider_window_state{provider="anthropic",window="seven_day",state="unavailable"}) * 4

4.text: Unavailable: newest observation has no valid reading for this window

panels.title: Window utilization seven_day
panels.description: Reported by the provider; not derived from token counts. Shown for current and stale windows only.
